app.name: Myntra - Fashion Shopping App
app.description: India's leading fashion and lifestyle shopping app for clothing, footwear, accessories and home furnishing for men, women and kids.

verdict.one_liner: Myntra tracks your shopping behavior, shares your data with third-party partners and group companies, and makes your product reviews public — but gives you ways to opt out of marketing and request data deletion.
verdict.summary: Myntra collects extensive personal data including your identity, payment details, shopping behavior, browsing history, and device information. This data is shared with group companies, third-party service providers (payment, delivery, logistics, CRM), advisors, and regulators. Your product reviews and photos become public. The app uses cookies and tracking technologies for analytics and marketing, though you can opt out of promotional communications. Data may be transferred outside India. You have rights to access, correct, and delete your data through a Privacy Center or by contacting the DPO. After two years of inactivity, your account data is deleted.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Myntra shares data broadly across its group companies and service partners, tracks your shopping behavior for ads, and makes your reviews public. While it offers decent user rights and opt-outs, users who are privacy-conscious should consider limiting what they share and turning off marketing communications.

red.title: Shares data with many partners
red.plain_english: Myntra shares your personal data with group companies, payment providers, delivery partners, logistics trackers, CRM services, auditors, lawyers, and regulators — and may transfer it all during a merger or sale.

red.title: Tracks shopping and browsing behavior
red.plain_english: Myntra collects your shopping preferences, browsing history, clicks, scrolls, and page interactions to build a profile of you for analytics and personalized marketing.

red.title: Product reviews and photos are public
red.plain_english: Any photos, images, or reviews you post on Myntra become public and can be read by anyone. Myntra may also use your images for marketing.

red.title: Data may leave the country
red.plain_english: Myntra may transfer, store, or process your personal data outside India, including where its servers are located, without always specifying which countries.

red.title: Policy changes don't need your active okay
red.plain_english: Myntra can update its privacy policy anytime by posting a new version. If you keep using the app, that means you accept the changes — you won't be asked to click agree again.

green.title: Can opt out of marketing messages
green.plain_english: You can unsubscribe from promotional emails and SMS by clicking the unsubscribe link or visiting the Privacy Center.

green.title: Data deletion and rights available
green.plain_english: You can access, correct, and delete your data through the Privacy Center or by writing to Myntra's Data Protection Officer.

green.title: Inactive accounts are deleted after 2 years
green.plain_english: If you don't use your account for two years, Myntra deletes your data including transaction history.

green.title: You can withdraw consent
green.plain_english: You have the right to withdraw your consent for data processing at any time.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Myntra may ask for camera access so you can upload photos for product reviews or returns. This is optional and only happens when you choose to upload an image.
categories.detail: The privacy policy states that product reviews with images are collected and may be used by Myntra. Camera access is not required for shopping but is used for user-initiated actions like posting review photos or return documentation.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to post reviews on our product review pages along with images, photos, or leave feedback/product review, we will collect that information you provide to us. Furthermore, we may use the images shared by you.
concerns: Review photos become public

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Myntra collects your general location (like your city or state) from your IP address for analytics and delivery purposes.
categories.detail: The privacy policy mentions collection of 'general location information such as city, state or geographic area' derived from IP address. There is no mention of precise GPS tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may automatically log and combine information about you... such as device data including... general location information such as city, state or geographic area.
concerns: IP-based location collected automatically

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Myntra does not access your phone's contacts. You can manually enter details of someone you are buying a gift for.
categories.detail: The policy mentions 'Data about others' where you may provide recipient details for purchases, but does not indicate that the app reads your phone's contact list.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may ask you to choose to provide data for whom you make a purchase, such as name, delivery address and phone number.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Myntra may ask to access your photo library when you want to upload images for product reviews or returns.
categories.detail: File access is user-initiated for optional features like posting review photos or attaching return images. The app does not mention continuous scanning of your photo library.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to post reviews on our product review pages along with images, photos... we will collect that information you provide to us.
concerns: Uploaded images may be used for marketing

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Myntra shares your data with group companies, payment providers, delivery partners, logistics trackers, customer management services, auditors, lawyers, and government authorities when required by law.
categories.detail: The privacy policy lists extensive third-party sharing: website hosting, payment providers, delivery and logistics partners, delivery tracking partners, customer relationship management partners, advisors, regulators, and law enforcement. Data may also be shared during mergers, acquisitions, or reorganizations.
categories.policy_excerpt: Personal data will also be shared with third party service providers... providers of website hosting and maintenance; payment providers; delivery and logistics partner; delivery tracking partners; and customer relationship management partner.
concerns: Data shared with broad category of service providers
Cross-border sharing with group companies
Data may be transferred during corporate transactions

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need an account with your phone number, email, and name to shop on Myntra. Your phone number is the primary identifier for your account.
categories.detail: The terms state that your mobile number is the 'primary identifier on the Platform.' The privacy policy lists identity data including name, telephone/mobile number, email ID, billing address, and shipping address as collected during registration and transactions.
categories.policy_excerpt: Some of the information that we may collect includes but is not limited to information provided to us during sign-up/registering or using our Platform such as name, telephone/mobile number, email ID.
concerns: Phone number is mandatory primary identifier
Address and identity data collected for every transaction

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Myntra tracks your shopping behavior, browsing history, clicks, and preferences to show you personalized ads and recommendations. You can opt out of promotional messages.
categories.detail: The policy collects 'shopping behaviour, preferences, your browsing history' and uses cookies and tracking technologies to 'enhance user experience, analyze website performance, and personalize content.' Marketing communications are sent with opt-out available. Product interaction data (page response times, clicks, scrolling, mouse-overs) is also collected.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect some of the information such as your shopping behaviour, preferences, your browsing history... We collect information about you through cookies and similar technologies to enhance user experience, analyze website performance, and personalize content.
concerns: Behavioral profiling for marketing
Cookies and tracking technologies used
Opt-out does not stop all tracking

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Myntra does not allow anyone under 18 to use the platform. If you share a child's data, you are responsible for having permission.
categories.detail: The privacy policy explicitly states the platform is only for people above 18 years of age and complies with local laws. It requires users to have authority if they share data about children under 18.
categories.policy_excerpt: We comply with local laws and do not allow children to register on our Platform when they are under the legal age limit of the country in which they reside. Use of our platform is only available to people who are above 18 years of age.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Myntra logs your IP address, browser type, and network info for security and to estimate your general location.
categories.detail: The policy collects device and network data including IP address, browser type, screen resolution, device type, and language settings automatically for security, analytics, and location estimation.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may automatically log and combine information about you... such as device data including your computer's operating system type and version, manufacturer and model, browser type, screen resolution, device type, IP address, unique identifiers, language settings.
concerns: IP address used for location inference

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Myntra collects detailed device information including your device type, operating system, unique identifiers, and screen resolution to track and identify your device.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly collects device data including OS type and version, manufacturer and model, browser type, screen resolution, device type, unique identifiers, and language settings. This is used for analytics and fraud prevention.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may automatically log and combine information about you, your computer or mobile device... such as device data including your computer's operating system type and version, manufacturer and model, browser type, screen resolution, device type, IP address, unique identifiers.
concerns: Unique device identifiers collected
Device fingerprinting for analytics and fraud prevention

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Myntra does not collect any health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention collection of health, fitness, or biometric data. Face ID or Touch ID for app login would be handled by iOS and not sent to Myntra.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Myntra collects your credit or debit card details and other payment information when you make a purchase, processed through third-party payment providers.
categories.detail: The policy states that transaction data including 'credit or debit card or other payment instrument information' is collected with consent during purchases. Payment processing is handled by third-party payment providers.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you transact with us, we may seek some additional information, such as billing address and shipping address from you... your credit or debit card or other payment instrument information, all of the above being in accordance with applicable law.
concerns: Payment data collected and stored
Third-party payment providers have access to transaction data

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can view, correct, and delete your data through Myntra's Privacy Center or by emailing the Data Protection Officer. After 2 years of inactivity, your account data is automatically deleted.
categories.detail: Users have rights to access, rectification, consent withdrawal, data portability, and deletion. Non-mandatory information can be deleted through Profile and Settings. Full requests can be sent to dpo@myntraglobal.com. The terms state that after two years of inactivity, data including transactional data is deleted.
categories.policy_excerpt: To exercise any of these rights, you may access, correct, and update your personal data directly through the functionalities provided on our Privacy Center page... If you are unable to exercise certain rights or edit specific information through the Platform, you may write to us at dpo@myntraglobal.com.
concerns: Some data may be retained after deletion for legal purposes
Not all data types deletable through self-service

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Myntra can change its privacy policy anytime by posting a new version with an updated date. If you keep shopping, that means you accept the changes.
categories.detail: The policy states that updates are made by posting a new notice and updating the 'Last Updated' date. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. There is no requirement for active re-consent or advance notice.
categories.policy_excerpt: When we update the Privacy Notice, we will notify you by updating the 'Last Updated' date at the bottom of the new Privacy Notice, posting the new Privacy Notice... By providing your information to us, or otherwise purchasing, accessing or using any product/service offered on the Platform after such notice had been given... you shall be deemed to have read and understood and agreed to the revised Privacy Notice.
concerns: No advance notice required
Continued use equals acceptance
No active re-consent mechanism
